callables.scope: Native and library invocation; shared, mutable and single-use receivers.
callables.restrictions: Native ABI and owned-capture restrictions apply. Adapter diagnostics retain legacy exceptions.

combinators.scope: Eager collection transformations, effects, traversal and validation.
combinators.restrictions: Capability requirements and origin/error admission remain operation-specific; legacy native inference remains restricted.

functions.scope: Selected Pipeline, legacy Piped, composition, partial application and Kleisli.
functions.restrictions: Pipeline migration is tracked below. Partial binds plain positional prefixes of up to eight operands. Declared Reader, State, Writer and IO carriers select their family; erased transformer layers and alternative policies still need explicit selection. Whole-recipe mapping uses then or explicit Identity. Pipeline.run delegates to selected Reader, State or Writer runners; IO retains run_io. IO pipelines expose run_io, guarantee and on_cancel through the existing IO contracts and owners. Selected local, listen and censor delegate through current-family capabilities; explicit lifted capabilities still use the free operations.

adt.scope: Algebraic choices and recursive data using native ownership.
adt.restrictions: Host qualification; device compilation does not establish GPU runtime support.

data.scope: Result, Optional integration, non-empty lists, Ior and Capture.
data.restrictions: Capture supports zero to eight owned positional operands; mixed conventions and homogeneous keyword packs support at most three positional operands; stored native pointers use kwargs as the pack name. Legacy attempt has diagnostic restrictions. Mixed Result folds accept plain functions and stored thin pointers directly; captures use BorrowSignature.capture or as_unary. Invalid native success handlers using mut in fold/fold_owned or var in fold can crash Mojo 1.2 during inference.

iteration.scope: Lazy native adapters, branches, alignment, scans and consuming terminals.
iteration.restrictions: Lazy callbacks cannot raise. Named shared callbacks retain their borrows in transforms, branches and immediate terminals; filter_map infers native Optional payloads, while generic symbolic forwarding retains explicit [U]. Branching requires an explicit buffer policy. Fallible source advancement and Resource scopes remain future contracts.

control.scope: Loops, state transitions and early termination.
control.restrictions: Native callback signatures and exact common raised errors remain part of admission. Invalid raw native fori_loop indices with mut Int, and while_loop predicates with var or mut carry arguments, can crash Mojo 1.2 during inference; library callable constraints reject normally.

algebra.scope: Family primitives, laws, shared traversal, sequential and accumulating policies.
algebra.restrictions: Public carrier and operation predicates are the generic extension contract. Native and deferred family admission preserve exact carrier, stored-error and origin requirements.

effects.scope: Reader, State, Writer and transformer capabilities.
effects.restrictions: Deferred computations retain callback borrows and alternative representations. Public carrier predicates validate each layer; Reader result admission uses the actual run origin. Carrier stability and Writer identity restrictions remain documented. ReaderAction and StateAction family metadata requires Functor; inference preserves each recipe's declared family. Selected Pipeline.run retains family admission, exact execution errors and origins; Writer unwraps without executing a deferred base. Fluent IO finalization preserves the exact IO family, skipped unopened scopes, masking and ordered failures; shared cancellation tokens are never reset.

matching.scope: Exhaustive value matching, guards and rewriting.
matching.restrictions: Up to sixteen noncapturing clauses and three subjects; matches borrow subjects and return owned values.

pipeline.name: Context
pipeline.families: Any selected Functor
pipeline.callbacks: No callback
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the context; get extracts its carrier.
pipeline.errors: raising selects native admission only.
pipeline.timing: No evaluation.

pipeline.name: Effect execution
pipeline.families: ReaderFamily, StateFamily or WriterFamily
pipeline.callbacks: The callbacks already owned or borrowed by the selected recipe.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the recipe; borrows a Reader environment, consumes State state, and moves the Writer base carrier.
pipeline.errors: The exact recipe execution error, independent of raising selection; Writer unwrapping raises Never.
pipeline.timing: Reader and State execute now; Writer unwraps and leaves a deferred base unexecuted.

pipeline.name: IO execution and finalization
pipeline.families: Selected IO[E]
pipeline.callbacks: Existing IO recipes; finalizers use the same exact IO error family. Outcome-aware cleanup accepts native borrowing callbacks, library borrowing callbacks or ScopedIO factories.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the pipeline and attached cleanup; native captures retain their ownership and origins.
pipeline.errors: Exact Outcome[Value, E], including ordered body and cleanup errors and cancellation state. No native error escapes run_io.
pipeline.timing: Composition is deferred. run_io executes synchronously; unopened scopes skip cleanup and tokens are never reset.

pipeline.name: Selected capability scopes
pipeline.families: Current family supplies Local, Listen or Censor; continuation uses the capability Family.
pipeline.callbacks: Native closure borrows and owned thin functions use existing descriptors; library callbacks retain their receivers and exact errors.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the recipe; local borrows its environment, listen copies its log once, and censor consumes a possibly move-only log. Appending binds the log by value; repeating bases copy that log without copying payloads.
pipeline.errors: Exact capability construction error; deferred execution retains exact callback errors and origins.
pipeline.timing: The capability and base family own evaluation, copies and scope restoration. Inner layers require an explicit lifted capability through the free operations.

pipeline.name: Payload operations
pipeline.families: Functor; Filterable, Monad or FunctorFilter where required
pipeline.callbacks: Native closures and thin pointers; library callable contracts retain receiver modes. Shared callable chains are borrowed directly by map, flat_map, filter_map. Named shared unary flow/compose chains use the same borrowed view admission. Unary partial applications are borrowed without copying their stored prefix; each invocation retains its documented bound-value copies. Stored NativeUnary adapters borrow their capture storage through the same shared view. Unary partials also expose their native borrowed-argument convention to selected predicates and observers, retaining named receiver storage without copying it. Direct Result and Piped Result predicates and observers also borrow named partials. Eager family filtering and lazy filters/prefixes share the borrowed partial admission.
pipeline.ownership: Transforms consume payloads; predicates and observers borrow them.
pipeline.errors: Exact family/callback error; stored errors retain their family.
pipeline.timing: Family-controlled, including deferred execution.

pipeline.name: Whole-value stages
pipeline.families: Whole carrier; then selects its output Functor
pipeline.callbacks: Native or library callbacks; tap uses BorrowCallable. Shared chains are borrowed by then and supply their selected family.
pipeline.ownership: then consumes the carrier; tap borrows and retains it.
pipeline.errors: Exact callback error, including Never.
pipeline.timing: One immediate invocation.

pipeline.name: Consuming folds
pipeline.families: Supported consuming iterable sources
pipeline.callbacks: Native or shared Binary callback.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the source and accumulator.
pipeline.errors: Exact step error.
pipeline.timing: Immediate; fold_until stops at Break.

pipeline.name: Applicative combination
pipeline.families: Selected Applicative
pipeline.callbacks: Native separate operands; library tuple/binary contracts. Stored n-ary thin pointers are owned and retain exact argument/result conventions.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes evaluated carriers; product_l/product_r retain one payload per successful pair. Cartesian output may require copies of both operands.
pipeline.errors: Family policy keeps or accumulates stored errors; native errors stay raised.
pipeline.timing: Family-controlled; target selection is unchanged.

pipeline.name: Traversal
pipeline.families: Traversable source; Applicative target; filtering also requires FunctorFilter; Native traversal methods infer native Optional, Result and List targets and declared effect recipes when J is omitted
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming transform or borrowing retention callback; single-use where the source permits. Shared callable chains are borrowed directly by traverse, preserving their selected effect family.
pipeline.ownership: Original move-only values retained when the target does not duplicate them.
pipeline.errors: Source errors, target failures and raised errors stay distinct.
pipeline.timing: Selects target family; Reader defers callbacks and compaction.

pipeline.name: Traversal composition
pipeline.families: Traversable source with FunctorFilter for compaction or Monad for flattening; Applicative target; native Optional, Result and List targets and declared effect recipes are inferred when J is omitted
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming native or library callback; sequence uses Identity. Source and target determine repeatability. Shared chains are borrowed directly and supply their selected target family.
pipeline.ownership: Move-only payloads survive compaction and flattening when the target does not duplicate them.
pipeline.errors: Source errors remain inside target effects; nested Result errors preserve the source family and origins.
pipeline.timing: Compaction and flattening run inside the target; source traversal retains its callback-construction timing.

pipeline.name: Discarded traversal
pipeline.families: Native iterator/owned iterable, or Result traversal; Applicative target; native Optional, Result and List targets and declared effect recipes are inferred when J is omitted
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming repeated transform for native sources; Result traversal can consume a single-use callback. Shared chains are borrowed directly and supply their selected target family.
pipeline.ownership: Discards successful payloads without an output collection. Array inputs use safe temporary storage.
pipeline.errors: Source Result errors remain nested; target failures and native raised errors stay distinct.
pipeline.timing: Uses target loop timing for native sources and source traversal timing for Result.

pipeline.name: Effectful queries and reductions
pipeline.families: Native source; infer native Optional, Result or List Monad targets. Explicit targets retain custom policies; fold_map_effect[Monoid] and combine_all_effect[Monoid] bind the combining rule and [Target, Monoid] also selects the effect.
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing predicates; consuming unary/binary transformations; repeatable shared or mutable library receivers. Bind fold_effect(initial).run(step). Shared chains are borrowed by find_map_effect and fold_map_effect, preserving their selected target family. sum_by_effect borrows shared chains and preserves their selected target, inferring numeric type and width.
pipeline.ownership: Moves inputs, retains first matches and releases partial accumulators; Arrays use O(N) temporary List storage. An unexecuted fold binding owns and destroys its source and seed.
pipeline.errors: Exact native errors, stored target failures and borrowed origins remain distinct.
pipeline.timing: Target owns branch stopping and deferral; monoid identity is constructed before source binding.

pipeline.name: Monad sequencing
pipeline.families: Selected Monad, including native, custom and deferred families; Validation requires explicit sequential Result selection
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing effect callbacks or zero-argument factories; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved
pipeline.ownership: Single-use effects move retained originals; branching effects require copyable retained originals and move projections
pipeline.errors: Exact family BindError at construction; deferred native errors stay deferred and remain distinct from stored failures
pipeline.timing: Selected Monad owns skipping, branching and deferral

pipeline.name: Family recovery
pipeline.families: Selected ApplicativeError, including native, custom and deferred families; intrinsic Result recovery remains available under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping
pipeline.callbacks: Handlers consume stored errors; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved. Named shared callable chains are borrowed without copying captures; explicit moves retain consuming admission.
pipeline.ownership: Success skips the handler; single-use carriers move owned captures, branching families require repeatable handlers
pipeline.errors: Exact family construction errors; deferred handler errors remain deferred. Canonical Result or_else may change the stored-error type and output family
pipeline.timing: Selected family owns recovery, even when its storage is a native Result

pipeline.name: Error observation
pipeline.families: Selected ApplicativeError, including Validation, custom and deferred families; intrinsic Result calls remain available under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing observers; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receiver modes preserved
pipeline.ownership: Success skips the observer; branching retains errors under the existing family copy rules; ordinary observation discards callback output
pipeline.errors: Exact construction and deferred native errors; Result observer failures replace the original, Validation accumulates observer-before-original
pipeline.timing: Selected family owns observation, failure reconstruction and combination; deferred effects remain deferred

pipeline.name: Conditional recovery
pipeline.families: Selected ApplicativeError, including Validation, custom and deferred families; intrinsic Result calls remain available under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing Bool predicate and consuming value or effect handler; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved; named shared handler chains are borrowed and explicit moves retain consuming admission
pipeline.ownership: Success skips both callbacks; only matching failures invoke the handler; family repeatability and move rules apply
pipeline.errors: Exact family construction errors; deferred predicate, handler and failure-constructor errors remain deferred; callback native errors agree unless one never raises
pipeline.timing: Selected family owns recovery and unmatched failure reconstruction; deferred effects remain deferred

pipeline.name: Success validation
pipeline.families: Selected ApplicativeError and Monad, including custom and deferred families; Validation has no Monad; intrinsic Result calls remain available under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping
pipeline.callbacks: Borrowing Bool predicate and borrowing stored-error factory; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved
pipeline.ownership: Existing failures skip both callbacks; accepted successes skip the factory; family bind admission and receiver rules apply
pipeline.errors: Exact family bind construction errors; deferred predicate, factory and failure-constructor errors remain deferred
pipeline.timing: Selected family owns bind and failure construction; deferred effects remain deferred

pipeline.name: Outcome handling
pipeline.families: ApplicativeError for values, plus Monad for effects; canonical Result and intrinsic Result under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping preserve type-changing effect handlers
pipeline.callbacks: Both handlers consume their original payload; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved; named shared chains are borrowed in either callback position, including mixed native/chain calls
pipeline.ownership: Only the original branch selects a handler; inactive callbacks are disposed; branching requires repeatable handlers; borrowed chains keep their captures and explicit moves transfer ownership
pipeline.errors: Exact family construction and deferred run errors; returned stored failures and native raises never invoke the opposite arm
pipeline.timing: Selected custom families own materialization and execution even with native Result storage; deferred callbacks remain deferred

pipeline.name: Whole-outcome observation
pipeline.families: Selected ApplicativeError and Monad, including custom and deferred families; intrinsic Result behavior remains under families with neither ApplicativeError nor ErrorMapping
pipeline.callbacks: Observer borrows the exact selected Result and returns an effect in that family; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved
pipeline.ownership: Successful observer branches retain the original outcome; empty effects remain empty; branching requires repeatable observers and copyable retained outcomes; single-use paths admit move-only values
pipeline.errors: Exact family construction and deferred observer/restoration errors; observer stored failures replace the original outcome
pipeline.timing: Selected family owns materialization, observation and restoration; deferred effects remain deferred; unselected outer errors skip observation

pipeline.name: Stored-error mapping
pipeline.families: Selected ErrorMapping: ResultFamily, ValidationFamily, ResultT, OptionalT/ReaderT/StateT/WriterT over a mapping-capable Monad, and custom families; mapping does not require ApplicativeError or copyable State; intrinsic Result remains under families with neither ErrorMapping nor ApplicativeError
pipeline.callbacks: Consuming branch callbacks; native closures borrowed, stored thin pointers owned, library receivers preserved; optional Target follows existing positional bindings and admits Functor aliases with an ErrorMapping capability check; named shared chains are borrowed in either callback position, including mixed native/chain calls
pipeline.ownership: One original branch consumes its payload and invokes its callback; unused owners are destroyed; exact payload/error and actual Reader run origins remain in the destination; State runs once without rollback/copy and Writer retains the exact log monoid; borrowed chains keep their captures and explicit moves transfer ownership
pipeline.errors: Exact family construction and callback errors remain native; Reader/State mapping construction is Never and their run errors stay deferred; Writer exposes its base construction error and preserves deferred base errors
pipeline.timing: One two-arm family primitive; ResultT uses one base map, OptionalT its existing success adapter, and Reader/State/Writer one shared _BimapOp through existing hoists/Writer transport; sources run under their original family; raw target bases must be Monad, while explicitly admitted Monad targets remain independent of unusable defaults

pipeline.name: Pure reductions
pipeline.families: Native iterator and owned iterable sources; result selects its native family
pipeline.callbacks: Repeatable consuming projections or shared borrowing keys; stored native thin pointers supported. Named unary partials, native adapters and shared compositions are borrowed by sum_by, fold_map and find_map; partial keys are borrowed by min_by and max_by. Explicit moves retain owned admission.
pipeline.ownership: Consume inputs; retain first extrema on ties and preserve result origins. Array uses shared temporary List conversion.
pipeline.errors: Exact callback or monoid errors; incompatible raised types reject at admission
pipeline.timing: Immediate ordered reduction; find_map stops without another pull, extrema evaluate each key once

pipeline.name: Structural conveniences
pipeline.families: Selected Functor, FunctorFilter, Monad or Applicative as required; compact follows MapFilteredFamily
pipeline.callbacks: ap consumes stored library callables; other methods use shared internal transforms
pipeline.ownership: Move source payloads; copied constants require Copyable. Branching application requires copyable operands.
pipeline.errors: Exact family and stored callable errors; source and target Result errors retain embedded origins
pipeline.timing: Family-owned ordering, accumulation and deferral; ap arguments are already evaluated

pipeline.name: Conditional factories
pipeline.families: Selected Monad with Bool payloads and matching branch payload/error types
pipeline.callbacks: Native zero-argument closures and thin pointers; single-use or repeatable library factories as required by the source
pipeline.ownership: Borrow native closures with exact origins; own thin pointers and library factories. Release skipped and abandoned captures.
pipeline.errors: Compatible exact native factory errors; stored Result errors remain in the carrier
pipeline.timing: Run only selected branches; absence/failure skips both. Family owns repeated calls and deferral.

pipeline.name: Accumulating policies
pipeline.families: Validation policy for native Results; n-ary methods retain the source family, traversal selects Result
pipeline.callbacks: Fixed native arities 1–8 or library tuple callables. Stored n-ary thin pointers are owned and retain exact argument/result conventions. Shared callable chains are borrowed directly by par_traverse.
pipeline.ownership: Consume evaluated operands, callbacks and sources; release unvisited inputs and partial output on native failure
pipeline.errors: Stored errors accumulate through an inferred ListMonoid or explicit Semigroup; native raises stop immediately
pipeline.timing: Ordered synchronous accumulation; a single n-ary operand never invokes the error combiner

pipeline.name: Result terminals
pipeline.families: A native Result carrier
pipeline.callbacks: Owned unary fallback for value_or; two borrowed-payload handlers for fold or owned-payload handlers for fold_owned; no callback for to_optional or raise_on_err. Named shared callable chains are borrowed without copying captures; explicit moves retain consuming admission.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the Result and owned library callbacks; native closures and named shared chains are borrowed. Returns a plain value or Optional.
pipeline.errors: Selected native error for closures, exact declared library error. Stored errors feed value_or or are discarded by to_optional. raise_on_err raises the stored error with its exact type and origins, independent of the selected callback error. fold and fold_owned return the active handler value directly; handler outputs and their origins must match, and raised errors must agree or be Never.
pipeline.timing: Immediate extraction; fold and fold_owned run exactly one handler, and value_or runs its fallback only on Err.

pipeline.name: Native sequence selection
pipeline.families: Native List, Array, Deque, LinkedList and NonEmptyList
pipeline.callbacks: No callback; subsequent operations retain their family requirements.
pipeline.ownership: Moves the carrier into its native element family without copying.
pipeline.errors: Preserves the selected native error context.
pipeline.timing: No iteration or callback evaluation during selection.

pipeline.name: Result case exchange
pipeline.families: A native Result carrier; selects the exchanged ResultFamily
pipeline.callbacks: No callback
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the Result and moves its active payload without copying; origins are retained.
pipeline.errors: Stored success/error types exchange; the selected native error is unchanged.
pipeline.timing: Immediate case exchange; it never raises a stored error.

pipeline.name: Default extraction
pipeline.families: Native Optional or Result carriers
pipeline.callbacks: Zero-argument native closures and thin pointers; shared, mutable or consuming library factories; get_or accepts an already evaluated payload instead of a callback
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the carrier and library factory, including skipped factory owners; native closures are borrowed. Returns the exact payload type. An unused get_or default is also destroyed.
pipeline.errors: Selected native error for native callbacks; exact declared library error. A stored Result error is discarded by its existing owned fold.
pipeline.timing: Returns a present/successful payload directly; calls the factory only on absence or Err. get_or arguments evaluate normally before the call; get_or itself is pure.

pipeline.name: Optional-to-Result conversion
pipeline.families: A native Optional carrier; selects ResultFamily with the inferred factory output as stored error
pipeline.callbacks: Zero-argument native closures and thin pointers; shared, mutable or consuming library factories
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the source and library factory, including skipped owners. Borrows native closures and retains exact payload/error origins.
pipeline.errors: Factory return values become stored errors; native exceptions propagate unchanged. The selected native error context is retained.
pipeline.timing: A present payload becomes Ok; only absence invokes the error factory.

pipeline.name: Selected effect execution output
pipeline.families: StateFamily or WriterFamily, retaining its base effect
pipeline.callbacks: The existing recipe callbacks and shared owned pair selector.
pipeline.ownership: Consumes the recipe and any initial State input; moves the selected output and disposes of the other without copying.
pipeline.errors: State retains the compatible native execution/map error; Writer retains native base-map construction errors. Both are independent of raising selection.
pipeline.timing: State runs with its initial input; Writer unwraps. Both map over the base and leave a deferred base unexecuted.
